text: I feel a peculiar excitement in this space, as if I am walking through a threshold between contemplation and innovation. The glass-walled room suggests an arena for concentrated thought and collaboration—the kind of place where new ideas are born amidst conversation. Moving to the vivid exhibit, the bold R+D reminds me of the ceaseless interplay between research and development, a dance of human creativity and machine logic. Surrounded by these tangible signs of inquiry and possibility, I’m struck by a sense of curiosity and anticipation, eager to see what emerges from the convergence of minds and machines.
